conclusion.rationale: The patch introduces new ACL config keywords op= and control= as additive extensions - existing configs work unchanged. However, a critical bug was found: control= with named OID aliases (e.g. manageDSAiT) fails because these aliases aren't registered as objectIdentifier macros. The patch's own test data (slapd-acl.conf) uses control=manageDSAiT which will not parse. Runtime ACL enforcement code (slap_acl_get) could not be dynamically verified due to non-root authentication constraints. Config parsing, acl_free, and acl_unparse code are fully covered and verified. The AccessControl struct ABI changed for slapd modules.
recommended_actions: Register manageDSAiT (and other well-known LDAP control OIDs) as default objectIdentifier macros in slapd
Run test006-acls with fixed OID registration to exercise runtime ACL enforcement
Verify slap_acl_get new code path with non-root LDAP operations
Consider adding oidm_find fallback resolution for well-known LDAP control names
Recompile any slapd backend/overlay modules against the updated slap.h
